water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Andaman Sea & deep water (> 80 m depth)

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Gulf of Thailand & coastal waters next to land or shallower than 80 m

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Major inland water bodies (Songkhla Lake, reservoirs)

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Lowland plains, Chao Phraya basin, Khorat Plateau & river deltas

relief.name: Hills
relief.rule: Foothills and uplands (roughness ≥ 55 m or elevation ≥ 350 m)

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Mountain ranges: Thanon Thong Chai, Tenasserim, Phetchabun & Sankamphaeng (roughness ≥ 160 m or elevation ≥ 900 m)

relief.name: Peaks
relief.rule: Highest summits including Doi Inthanon & northern ridges (max elevation ≥ 1,600 m and high relief)

cover.name: Monsoon & deciduous forest
cover.rule: ESA WorldCover tree cover (class 10) in drier northern & northeastern basins

cover.name: Tropical rainforest
cover.rule: ESA WorldCover tree cover (class 10) in southern peninsula, eastern coast & highland ridges

cover.name: Mixed tropical forest
cover.rule: ESA WorldCover tree cover (class 10) in transitional uplands

cover.name: Rice & cropland
cover.rule: ESA WorldCover cropland (class 40): Chao Phraya & Isan rice paddies, cassava, sugarcane

cover.name: Mangroves & wetland
cover.rule: ESA WorldCover herbaceous wetland (90) & coastal mangroves (95)

cover.name: Built-up urban
cover.rule: ESA WorldCover built-up (class 50) ≥ 22% of land samples
